en.summary: The commit fixes SGPR and VGPR bank depth so register-file storage matches the configured architected slot counts instead of a smaller warp-count formula.
why_it_counts: It changes active Chisel storage declarations in the DUT register file.
The old formula ignored NUMBER_SGPR_SLOTS and NUMBER_VGPR_SLOTS, which are the explicit architectural capacity parameters.
Using too few physical rows causes architected registers to alias onto the same bank entries.
evidence: RegFileBank changes SyncReadMem depth from 32*num_warp/num_bank to NUMBER_SGPR_SLOTS/num_bank.
FloatRegFileBank changes SyncReadMem depth from 32*num_warp/num_bank to NUMBER_VGPR_SLOTS/num_bank.
The commit leaves the rest of the bank logic intact, so the functional fix is specifically the storage-depth correction.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A banked register file must size each physical memory bank to cover the full architected scalar or vector register capacity. If bank depth is derived from a smaller heuristic such as warp count instead of the configured slot count, different architected registers alias onto the same physical rows and later writes overwrite unrelated state.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Software or hardware allocates enough scalar or vector registers to reach indices beyond the mistakenly shallow physical bank depth.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Under-size each bank memory using a smaller formula derived from warp count or another proxy instead of the actual configured register-slot capacity.
portability_notes: Apply this to any banked scalar or vector register file whose physical memory depth is parameterized.
Use the fault where the design has distinct architectural slot-count parameters but the buggy implementation ignores them.
For consistency, inject the same shallow-depth rule into every bank type that should share the architectural capacity model.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the physical memory declaration for each scalar or vector register-file bank.
Replace the depth expression based on configured slot counts with a smaller expression based only on warp count, lane count, or another incomplete proxy.
Keep the bank indexing and read/write control logic unchanged so aliasing appears only through insufficient capacity.
Drive workloads or tests that access high register indices or many resident waves.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes scalar-bank depth to NUMBER_SGPR_SLOTS/num_bank and vector-bank depth to NUMBER_VGPR_SLOTS/num_bank instead of the smaller 32*num_warp/num_bank formula.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore the old SyncReadMem depth formula 32*num_warp/num_bank in both RegFileBank and FloatRegFileBank within ventus/src/pipeline/regfile.scala.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: High-index SGPR or VGPR accesses alias onto the same physical bank rows, causing silent register corruption on reads and writes.
evidence_for_injection: Both scalar and vector bank declarations are fixed in the same commit.
The old depth formula depends only on num_warp and ignores NUMBER_SGPR_SLOTS and NUMBER_VGPR_SLOTS entirely.
No control-path logic changes accompany the patch, which isolates the bug to physical storage capacity.
notes: This is a strong cross-DUT injection target because bank-depth underprovisioning is common in parameterized register files.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 SGPR 和 VGPR bank 的深度计算，使寄存器文件存储容量与配置的架构 slot 数一致，而不是使用更小的基于 warp 数的公式。
why_it_counts: 它修改的是 DUT 寄存器文件中的活动 Chisel 存储声明。
旧公式忽略了 NUMBER_SGPR_SLOTS 和 NUMBER_VGPR_SLOTS 这两个明确的架构容量参数。
物理行数过少会让多个架构寄存器混叠到同一 bank entry 上。
evidence: RegFileBank 把 SyncReadMem 深度从 32*num_warp/num_bank 改为 NUMBER_SGPR_SLOTS/num_bank。
FloatRegFileBank 把 SyncReadMem 深度从 32*num_warp/num_bank 改为 NUMBER_VGPR_SLOTS/num_bank。
提交没有改动其余 bank 逻辑，因此真正的功能修复点就是存储深度修正。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 带 bank 的寄存器文件必须为每个物理 bank 分配足够深度，以覆盖完整的架构标量或向量寄存器容量。如果 bank 深度不是基于配置好的 slot 数，而是错误地基于 warp 数等较小代理量来计算，不同的架构寄存器就会映射到同一物理行，后续写入会覆盖无关状态。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 带 bank 的寄存器文件存储深度
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 软件或硬件分配了足够多的标量或向量寄存器，访问的索引超出了被错误缩小的物理 bank 深度。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 不要按真实的寄存器 slot 容量配置 bank 深度，而是用基于 warp 数或其它代理量的更小公式来缩小每个 bank 的存储。
portability_notes: 可映射到任何物理 bank 深度可参数化的标量或向量寄存器文件。
当设计同时存在明确的架构 slot 参数，而实现却忽略它们时，这个故障最具代表性。
为了行为一致，所有共享同一架构容量模型的 bank 类型都应注入相同的浅深度规则。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到每个标量或向量寄存器文件 bank 的物理存储声明。
把基于配置 slot 数的深度表达式替换成仅基于 warp 数、lane 数或其它不完整代理量的更小表达式。
保持 bank 索引和读写控制逻辑不变，让错误只通过存储容量不足体现出来。
运行会访问高寄存器索引或大量常驻 wave 的工作负载。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: RegFileBank 和 FloatRegFileBank 的 SyncReadMem 深度
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把标量 bank 深度改成 NUMBER_SGPR_SLOTS/num_bank，把向量 bank 深度改成 NUMBER_VGPR_SLOTS/num_bank，而不是更小的 32*num_warp/num_bank。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 ventus/src/pipeline/regfile.scala 中，把 RegFileBank 和 FloatRegFileBank 的 SyncReadMem 深度恢复成旧的 32*num_warp/num_bank 公式。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 高索引的 SGPR 或 VGPR 访问会混叠到相同的物理 bank 行上，导致静默的寄存器读写损坏。
evidence_for_injection: 提交在同一次修改中同时修复了标量和向量 bank 的声明。
旧深度公式只依赖 num_warp，完全忽略了 NUMBER_SGPR_SLOTS 和 NUMBER_VGPR_SLOTS。
补丁没有伴随任何控制路径改动，因此 bug 被明确隔离在物理存储容量上。
notes: 这是很强的跨 DUT 注入目标，因为 bank 深度配置不足是参数化寄存器文件中的常见错误。
